newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sega, Bandai to sign merger agreement on May 28.
newsitem.headline: Sega, Bandai to sign merger agreement on May 28.

text.p: Bandai Co Ltd said on Tuesday that it would sign a merger agreement with Sega Enterprises Ltd on May 28.
The merger will take place on October 1 as scheduled, a Bandai spokeswoman said.
Bandai and Sega will postpone their earnings report for 1996/97 which ended on March 31, to May 28, she added.
In January, toy maker Bandai and game-machine manufacturer Sega said they would merge on October 1 to build what they said would be a "formidable force" in the media entertainment business.
However, Bandai president Makoto Yamashina has said that the merger could fall behind schedule as the two companies were carefully hammering out rules for the new merged company.
